subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

As she grew older, she began to question the religious teachings of her youth and became more __**agnostic**__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"agnostic"** means a person who believes that nothing is known or can be known of the existence or nature of God. (अज्ञेयवादी)

 
 
• **Example: **After years of studying different religions, she identified herself as **agnostic.**
 
 
 
• **"Skeptic" **refers to a person inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions. (संशयवादी)
 
 
• **Example: **He was a **skeptic** who always questioned the validity of scientific claims without evidence.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the **synonym** of **'agnostic' **is **'skeptic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Demonic **(पिशाच): Relating to or characteristic of demons or evil spirits.

 
 
• **Example:** The film portrayed demonic entities terrorizing the village.
 
 
 
• **Religious **(धार्मिक): Relating to or believing in a religion.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a very religious person who attends church every Sunday.
 
 
 
• **Godly** (धार्मिक): Devoutly religious; pious.
 
 
• **Example:** She led a godly life dedicated to helping others and serving her faith.
 
 

37:Tbfb,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**<
